mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and real GDP growth indicate convergent consumer demand signals; their interaction produces multiplicative positive equity returns as both factors jointly strengthen economic expansion.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and GDPC1 on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates above 0.2pp in 3 months signal monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production output above 100 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 600.0 thousand units indicate weakening residential demand, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) creates multiplicative positive feedback: low rates amplify employment-driven consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The interaction term between PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS does not significantly predict SPX returns (p > 0.05) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeding 2.5% during late-cycle expansions triggers central bank rate hikes that increase equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m % change > 2.5.
